primary_claim: In LinuxArena, a monitor caught 7/15 commission attacks at a 2% FPR but 0/15 omission attacks, and this remained 0/15 even after rewriting the monitor prompt to specifically target omissions.
stated_future_work: build a benchmark for omission attacks and omission monitors covering both attacker ability and monitorability
measure fix rates: which models can fix the sabotaged research when given a few tries
try resampling trajectories and have the monitor scan for inconsistencies to incriminate the attacker
test omission in the CoT: can an attacker omit an action AND any reasoning about it
allow the attacker to write the test suite given the main task spec, to see if it can hide omissions by omitting a test that would catch it
quote: At a 2% FPR, the basic LinuxArena monitor caught seven out of the fifteen commission attacks, and caught none of the omission attacks.
